title: kbmon names an orphan process only after a minute and says when it has a live child, never that nothing waits for it
goal: kbmon's sessions headline and needs-you line name an orphan process (bl_procs class orphan) only once it is at least 60 s old, say 'with a live child' when one of its children still runs (an sh loop around sleep, as pids 46638 and 88109 were on 2026-11-08), and drop the claim 'nothing waits for them', which the code cannot know (mon_status prints it today, and listed 'orphan pid 86144, running 1s'). The worker plants an orphan sh with a sleep child in a scratch directory to prove each case.

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','sessions','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or 'nothing waits for them' in r.stdout)
